infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LazyNavy uses your location to record voyage and shore visit tracks while the app is open.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LazyNavy uses your camera so you can take a profile avatar or background photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LazyNavy uses your photo library so you can choose a profile avatar or background.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: LazyNavy uses Face ID to unlock your protected app session.
